question_text: Compare a fixed-capacity array and a dynamic linked list for a workload whose number of records varies greatly.
adaptation_rationale: Original application rewritten to be self-contained; assessed reasoning retained within cited 2027 scope.
solution: Array capacity is chosen in advance; linked list can add/remove nodes as required.; Array may waste spare capacity or overflow; linked list uses per-node reference/allocation overhead.; Array gives direct index access whereas locating an arbitrary indexed node in a linked list requires traversal.
